description.p: Added:

ul.li: Script vector mix and lengthSqr helpers.

description.p: Fixes:
Improved:
Fixed: Camera shake motion.
Fixed: Parenting script bone lookup for puppet layers and script-created nodes.
Fixed: Particle emitter origin scaling for scaled parent layers.
Fixed: Culling and shader uniform regressions affecting layered scene rendering.
Fixed: Draw the first frame when paused.
Added: Waywallen plugin build CI and plugin packages.
Added: Camera shake, camera paths and 3D scene/model rendering support.
Added: Particle geometry-shader rendering for sprite particles.
Changed: Refactored scene document loading so early scene metadata is reused by the full parse path.
Changed: Plugin bundle archives now install with plugin.toml at the archive root.
Fixed: Legacy user shader values, scripted camera paths, scripted effect transforms and animation stub handling.
Fixed: Single puppet animations and MDLV21 puppet animation hierarchy/additive poses.
Fixed: Particle emitter ranges, child particles and high-count particle point generation.
Fixed: 3D depth rendering and depth ordering for mixed 2D/3D scenes.
Fixed: Build and CI dependencies for Clang modules, ALSA, glslang and expat.
Added: Audio-response support for the Wallpaper Engine web renderer.
Changed: Renderer binaries are installed under bin, with the web runtime under bin/weweb.
Changed: Renderer component versions are no longer duplicated in plugin manifests.
Added: Scanning of bundled defaultprojects and user-authored myprojects wallpapers.
Added: Perspective scene cameras now follow the scene's camera object, with a lookat fallback.
Added: WEVector scripting module, unblocking audio-visualizer wallpapers.
Added: Content rating metadata on scanned wallpapers.
Changed: Reworked the waywallen plugin layout.
Changed: Broader spec-texture name coverage for layer composites and self-links.
Fixed: Off-aspect scene wallpapers are no longer stretched.
Fixed: Point-sampled (noInterpolation) image layers stay point-sampled through the whole effect chain.
Fixed: Cross-stage shader varyings are widened to the wider declared type.
Fixed: Dynamic text content render-target width.
Fixed: Audio-bar fanout ordering.
Fixed: ApplyBlending override and stray shadowAtlas handling.
Community: Merged #13 (@burlone0): fix off-aspect scene wallpapers being stretched.
Community: Fixed #12: point-art image layers losing their nearest filtering.
Added: Support for newest puppet (MDLV21) wallpapers, including skinning, submeshes and clip masks.
Added: Scripting support for SceneNode, setTimeout, cursor, localStorage, WEMath and createLayer.
Added: Audio-reactive shaders driven by the wavsen spectrum.
Added: User properties on scene layers, including scripted updates.
Added: System and workshop font resolution.
Added: A resolution setting.
Changed: Switched the shader frontend from DXC to glslang for broader HLSL compatibility.
Changed: Audio spectrum bars are now smoother and frame-rate independent.
Changed: Text alignment now follows the original horizontalalign / verticalalign fields.
Fixed: Particle movement and controlpointattract behavior.
Fixed: Rope rendering and link_mouse follow.
Fixed: Puppet animation speed on multi-pass layers.
Fixed: Various Vulkan synchronization issues.
Community: Merged #6 (@Shnimlz): audio-responsive particles and scripted scene user properties.
